response.text: Some findings so far: the character columns look unpadded in the output, no invoice has status V, and every journal is posted. Next I'll check the relationships and balances.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'char_len_vend' k, length("VEND_CD")::text a, count(*) c FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL
SELECT 'char_len_acct', length("ACCT_CD")::text, count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL
SELECT 'inv_orphan_vend', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL
SELECT 'inv_orphan_jrnl', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL
SELECT 'pay_orphan_inv', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID") UNION ALL
SELECT 'line_orphan_hdr', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL
SELECT 'line_orphan_acct', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL
SELECT 'hdr_orphan_prd', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL
SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL
SELECT 'unbalanced_jrnl', count(*)::text, 0 FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_jrnl_no', count(*)::text, 0 FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_line', count(*)::text, 0 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO","LN_SEQ" HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_inv_id', count(*)::text, 0 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "INV_ID" HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_vend_inv_no', count(*)::text, 0 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "VEND_CD","INV_NO" HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_or_both_lines', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 OR ("DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0) OR ("DR_AMT" IS NULL) OR ("CR_AMT" IS NULL) UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_inv', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0 UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_pay', count(*)::text, 0 FROM "APPAYM" WHERE "PAY_AMT"<=0
